articles.summary: Phoenix-4 is the first real-time model to generate and control emotional states, active listening behavior, and continuous facial motion as a single, unified system. It is a real-time behavior generation engine, built from the ground up, that goes beyond photorealism to transform conversation data into emotionally responsive, context-aware facial expression and head motion with millisecond-level latency.
articles.title: Phoenix-4: Real-Time Human Rendering with Emotional Intelligence
